title: Buyer Terms for Title & Registration Services: Document Return Periods and Inspection Requirements
content:
The buyer of a vehicle under Title & Registration Services is asked to return every required document within the document return period of the order's service type, counted in calendar days after the order is opened, the opening date being day 0. Where the service type requires a VIN inspection and an emissions certificate, they are obtained within the inspection period counted in calendar days after handover. After a state rejection that needs a corrected document, the buyer has the corrected-document period to supply it.

| Service type | Document return period (calendar days after opening) | Inspection period (calendar days after handover; 0 means not required) | Who may perform the VIN inspection | Emissions certificate required only for addresses in the state's emissions counties | Corrected-document period after a rejection (calendar days) | Signed odometer affidavit required on an odometer discrepancy rejection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Title-Only Service | 10 | 0 | not applicable | No | 10 | Yes |
| Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer | 10 | 0 | not applicable | No | 10 | Yes |
| Kestrel In-State New Registration | 10 | 0 | not applicable | No | 10 | Yes |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | 14 | 0 | not applicable | No | 10 | Yes |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | 21 | 20 | a state inspection station, law enforcement or a licensed dealer | Yes | 10 | Yes |
| Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | 14 | 0 | not applicable | No | 10 | Yes |

## Points of the terms

- **Counting from day 0.** The opening date itself is day 0, so the last day of a 14-day return period is the fourteenth calendar day after the opening date. Hypothetical example: an order opened on 1 March under a 14-day period has 15 March as its last day; documents returned on 15 March are within the period, documents returned on 16 March are not.
- **Inspection period.** Only Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection carries an inspection period (20 days after handover); every other service type shows 0, meaning no inspection is required. Hypothetical example: for a handover on 10 June, the last day of the 20-day period is 30 June.
- **Emissions counties.** Under Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection the emissions certificate is required only where the registration address lies in one of the state's emissions counties.
- **Odometer discrepancy.** For every service type, a state rejection for an odometer discrepancy calls for a signed odometer affidavit from the buyer.
